Commentary.Commentary: Just over 15 overs to go in the day and Bangladesh will aim for a wicket or two at least. Ireland on the other hand, will hope they can get through this tricky period without much damage. An interesting passage awaits.

It was the middle and the lower order which came to the fore for the hosts! They lost their top three early but Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim put up a brilliant side to turn the tide towards them. Shakib fell but Rahim continued. Along with Das, he took his side into the lead. Rahim got to his ton but Das missed out on a half ton. Mushfiqur Rahim and Mehidy Hasan then paired up to forge another partnership. However, the last session saw wickets fall quickly for the home side. Mehidy Hasan though added a few handy runs with the tail to push that lead over the 150-run mark.

Ireland will be pretty pleased with the work they have put in, in this session so far. They needed to pick up wickets very quickly and Andy McBrine has stepped up for them. He was the star for them with the ball with a six-fer and he was well supported by White as the two were bowling in tandom. Despite those efforts though it is Bangladesh who are well, well ahead in the game. They have a lead of 155 and the way this wicket has stated playing, that seems to be a massive advantage.

OUT! STUMPED! There is the last wicket and it is Benjamin White who gets it. Mehidy Hasan falls. He steps out but the White shortens the length. Mehidy Hasan looks to defend as he does not get to the pitch of the ball. The ball though turns away and goes past the outside edge. The keeper does the rest. BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 369!

Bangladesh would want the same to continue, there is a lot of time in the game left and they would want to bat for as long as possible. What a session for Bangladesh! They have scored more than 130 at a quick rate and trail now by just 44 runs. The hosts lost Mominul Haque early on but once Shakib Al Hasan came in and changed the complexion of the game. He just started to hit boundaries regularly and in no time raced away to his fifty. Rahim too followed him with his fifty. Ireland on the other hand had the start they wanted but as the game progressed, they had to chase the ball more often than before. If it continues the same way, Ireland will be giving away a huge lead. They have to try and take wickets in the next session quickly. A huge session coming up for Ireland. Stay tuned.
